description: Stable host error codes (§4.2, §6.2, §6.3, §9.7). Hosts and adapters return these codes verbatim; any other code is a contract violation. scope post-v1 codes are reserved: v1 never sends targets or merges human text.

codes.meaning: Same op key, different bytes. A bug; surfaced, never retried.
A citation does not resolve to a person turn or document segment in the hydrated closure, or its chain passes through assistant records.
Accept or replace on a proposal that a replacement already superseded.
Replace on an accepted proposal; acceptance is terminal for the item in v1.
Proposal or accept with a target whose base moved.
Another proposal was already accepted on the same target.
The target has no recorded content to refine.
The target's current text was written by a person; no automatic merge.
The token's gen is not the session's current worker generation.
The auth epoch changed or a tombstone exists; stop capture, output and new claims.
Unsupported major, or reader minor below min_reader.
The hold was already claimed; a resend needs a new attempt, hold and claim.
Admission refused at a session, principal/day or tenant/day cap, or for missing evidence.
